sittings.bodyEn: Answer, then stop. Weekday evenings and weekends. Today 18:00 works. Daytime has MBA class. Fixed evenings wait until you check this term’s timetable.
sittings.mandarin: 工作日晚上，还有周末。今天这个 18:00 可以。白天有 MBA 的课。固定哪几天晚上，对完这学期课表再回复。

sittings.bodyEn: Near ZJU Zijingang. Do not name a specific compound first. Interview place is 杭州市余杭区洋帆中心1幢21楼.
sittings.mandarin: 浙大紫金港附近。具体小区不必先报。面试在杭州市余杭区洋帆中心1幢21楼。

sittings.bodyEn: You did not rewrite the resume into a secretary resume. They want someone who helps the boss with company management. You did ops-director assistant work in Indonesia, so you came to listen. Fit means assistant work; no fit means say so today.
sittings.mandarin: 我没有把简历改成秘书简历。你们要的是帮老板做公司管理的人，我在印尼做过运营总监助理，所以来听。合适就做助理的事。不合适今天说清楚。

sittings.bodyEn: The post says 8 to 12K. First confirm whether that is daytime full-time. If evenings and weekends, learn weekly hours first, then talk numbers. Do not invent a new expected salary today.
sittings.mandarin: 帖子上是 8 到 12K。先确认是不是白天全职的范围。如果是晚上和周末，先知道每周大概多少小时，再谈数字。今天不报新的期望薪资。

sittings.bodyEn: Do not lock a start date today. If it fits, check the timetable this week, then give a date you can start.
sittings.mandarin: 今天不定日子。合适的话，这周对完课表再给一个可以开始的日期。

sittings.bodyEn: Work communication is ok. Chat, notes, simple email ok. Formal official documents are not strong. English writing ok. Indonesian is native. If they speak fast, ask them to repeat.
sittings.mandarin: 工作沟通可以。聊天、纪要、简单邮件可以。正式公文不熟练。英文可以写，印尼文是母语。说快时请再说一遍。

sittings.bodyEn: Calendar and reminders, meeting notes, follow-up, one-page pre-meeting brief, Chinese-English materials, Indonesian and English external drafts.
sittings.mandarin: 日历和提醒、会议纪要、待办跟进、会前一页纸、中英材料、印尼语和英语对外沟通草稿。

sittings.bodyEn: Boss private life, family matters, private finance. Company chops, contract signing, corporate payments. China government and official-document reception. If that is the main work, ask them to say so directly.
sittings.mandarin: 老板私人生活、家里的事、私人财务；公章、合同签字、对公付款；中国政府和公文接待。如果这是主要工作，请直接告诉我。

sittings.titleEn: Not here to build their AI
sittings.bodyEn: Not today’s role. Today you applied as assistant. AI is a way to make materials faster, not a pitch to rebuild their product.
sittings.mandarin: 不是今天这个岗位。今天应的是助理。AI 是把材料做快的方法，不是来改你们的产品。

sittings.bodyEn: That resume is for AI application internships. This 总办 conversation came later. Full-time MBA: do not promise daytime full-time first.
sittings.mandarin: 那份简历是给 AI 应用实习用的。总办这个对话是后来的。全日制 MBA，白天全职不能先答应。

sittings.bodyEn: Resume only says Indonesian nationality and full-time MBA. Do not guess visa type. Check documents later. Do not lock full-time onboarding today.
sittings.mandarin: 我按学生身份能做的范围，回去核对证件后再确认。今天我不定全职入职。

sittings.bodyEn: Recall the honest pay line. No invented new salary number today.
sittings.prompt: What do you say about 8–12K today?
choices: Confirm if daytime full-time; if evenings/weekends learn hours first; no new expected salary today
Say 8K to please them and lock it
Ignore hours and invent a monthly package
